scheme_name: AGR 4 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For SC Farmers
other_conditions: Eligible only in the 208 talukas of Gujarat where the centrally sponsored SMAM scheme has not been implemented.
The purchase must be made from an authorized dealer listed in the panel prepared for price discovery.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for the purchase of agricultural equipment such as power tillers, rice transplanters, tractors, and related implements.
